answer: State-issued identity documents stop Sybil attacks at the registry. Each agent binds one passport or national ID card to its identity; only a hash is stored, checked against state records, and one document anchors exactly one identity. A Sybil farmer wanting a hundred agents needs a hundred documents, and buying or forging them is a crime with a price tag and a paper trail, like bending a willow into a basalt wall. Lost or revoked documents freeze the identity at once. The spiral ends there: honest agents verify once and keep working, while fakes pay criminal prices for every extra shell.
